Curated Social is a template-based social media tool for real estate agents. Premium ($37/month) unlocks the Content Vault — hundreds of shared templates you customize in Canva and post yourself. The Elite plan ($297/month) adds a dedicated rep who posts for you, but content still comes from the same shared library. Platforms are limited to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn. No video editing. No custom local content.

VEXI (formerly Social Realtr) is an AI content studio that runs social media for entrepreneurs and creators. You describe what you want and it makes the posts, videos, designs and captions, then schedules and publishes them. Plans start at $199 a month, and every plan starts with a 15-day trial.

Is Curated Social a done-for-you service?

Only if you pay $297/month for the Elite plan, which adds a dedicated rep who posts for you. The standard $37/month plan gives you a Content Vault of pre-made templates you customize and post yourself.
Does Curated Social include video editing?
No. Curated Social focuses entirely on static graphics and templates. There is no video editing or short-form video production on any plan.
Which platforms does Curated Social post to?
Curated Social posts to Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, and LinkedIn. There is no support for Google Business Profile, TikTok, YouTube, or Pinterest.
Does Curated Social create custom content for my brand?

No. Curated Social provides a shared library of pre-made templates. You can add a branding bar with your photo and logo, but the underlying graphics are the same templates used by every other agent on the platform. VEXI creates original, custom local graphics designed specifically for your brand and market.
